passage: While travelling at a constant velocity of $108\text{ km}\cdot\text{h}^{-1}$, the driver of a car notices a sign warning motorists to keep a safe 2-second following distance. At that instant the car is $80\text{ m}$ behind a truck that is travelling at a constant velocity of $90\text{ km}\cdot\text{h}^{-1}$.
question: Calculate the safe 2-second following distance behind the truck.
memo:
$v_{	ext{truck}} = 90 \div 3,6 = 25	ext{ m}\cdot	ext{s}^{-1}$ $\checkmark$
$\Delta x_{	ext{truck}} = v \Delta t = (25)(2) = 50	ext{ m}$ $\checkmark$
$v_{	ext{car}} = 108 \div 3,6 = 30	ext{ m}\cdot	ext{s}^{-1}$ $\checkmark$
$\Delta x_{	ext{car}} = v \Delta t = (30)(2) = 60	ext{ m}$ $\checkmark$
Safe distance $= \Delta x_{	ext{car}} - \Delta x_{	ext{truck}}$ (or equivalent logic)
Total distance $= 50	ext{ m}$ $\checkmark \checkmark$

subject: physical_sciences
passage: While travelling at a constant velocity of $108\text{ km}\cdot\text{h}^{-1}$, the driver of a car notices a sign warning motorists to keep a safe 2-second following distance. At that instant the car is $80\text{ m}$ behind a truck that is travelling at a constant velocity of $90\text{ km}\cdot\text{h}^{-1}$.
question: Calculate how long it will take the motorist to get to a safe 2-second following distance behind the truck.
memo:
Distance to cover: $\Delta x = 80 + 50 - 60 = 70	ext{ m}$ (or $\Delta x_{	ext{car}} = 80 + \Delta x_{	ext{truck}}$)
$v_{	ext{car}} = 30	ext{ m}\cdot	ext{s}^{-1}$, $v_{	ext{truck}} = 25	ext{ m}\cdot	ext{s}^{-1}$
Using relative velocity:
$v_{	ext{rel}} = 30 - 25 = 5	ext{ m}\cdot	ext{s}^{-1}$ $\checkmark$
Distance to close gap $= 80 - 50 = 30	ext{ m}$ $\checkmark$
$\Delta t =  rac{\Delta x}{v_{	ext{rel}}} =  rac{30}{5}$ $\checkmark$
$= 6	ext{ s}$ $\checkmark$
